sentences.text: Dans la salle d'attente, Lucas lit un article sur les enfants obèses et le sucre caché dans les boissons.
sentences.en: In the waiting room, Lucas reads an article about obese children and the sugar hidden in drinks.
sentences.ko: 대기실에서 뤼카는 비만 아이들과 음료 속 숨은 설탕에 관한 기사를 읽어요.

sentences.text: Camille remarque que son chat devient presque obèse chaque hiver, faute de sortir.
sentences.en: Camille notices her cat becomes almost obese every winter from not going out.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 고양이가 겨울마다 밖에 안 나가서 거의 비만이 된다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste conseille à Lucas un fauteuil plus adapté à cause de ses douleurs à la colonne vertébrale.
sentences.en: The dentist recommends a better-suited chair for Lucas because of his spinal pain.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 척추 통증이 있는 뤼카에게 더 맞는 의자를 권해요.

sentences.text: Avec le froid, Camille a mal au dos et son kiné lui parle de la colonne vertébrale.
sentences.en: With the cold, Camille's back hurts and her physio talks to her about her spine.
sentences.ko: 추위에 허리가 아픈 카미유에게 물리치료사가 척추 이야기를 해요.

sentences.text: L'assistant dentaire de Lucas est un grand gaillard musclé qui parle très doucement.
sentences.en: Lucas's dental assistant is a big muscular guy who speaks very softly.
sentences.ko: 뤼카의 치과 조무사는 아주 조용히 말하는 덩치 큰 근육질 남자예요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Camille voit les joggeurs musclés revenir en masse au bord du canal.
sentences.en: In spring, Camille sees the muscular joggers return in droves along the canal.
sentences.ko: 봄이 되면 카미유는 운하 옆에 근육질 조깅족이 대거 돌아오는 걸 봐요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste demande à Lucas s'il a déjà ressenti des douleurs thoraciques pendant un soin.
sentences.en: The dentist asks Lucas if he has ever felt chest pain during treatment.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카에게 치료 중에 가슴 통증을 느낀 적이 있냐고 물어요.

sentences.text: L'air glacé de janvier provoque chez Camille une légère gêne thoracique quand elle court.
sentences.en: The icy January air gives Camille slight chest discomfort when she runs.
sentences.ko: 일월의 찬 공기 때문에 카미유는 달릴 때 가슴이 조금 답답해요.

sentences.text: En voyant ses dents jaunies, le dentiste devine tout de suite que Lucas est un gros fumeur.
sentences.en: Seeing his yellowed teeth, the dentist immediately guesses Lucas is a heavy smoker.
sentences.ko: 누레진 이를 보자 치과 의사는 뤼카가 담배를 많이 피운다는 걸 바로 알아채요.

sentences.text: Le voisin de Camille, ancien fumeur, dit qu'il sent enfin l'odeur des lilas au printemps.
sentences.en: Camille's neighbor, a former smoker, says he can finally smell the lilacs in spring.
sentences.ko: 담배를 끊은 카미유의 이웃은 봄이면 드디어 라일락 향기가 난다고 해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste rassure Lucas : inutile de l'hospitaliser pour retirer une dent de sagesse.
sentences.en: The dentist reassures Lucas that there's no need to hospitalize him to remove a wisdom tooth.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 사랑니를 빼는 데 입원할 필요는 없다며 뤼카를 안심시켜요.

sentences.text: L'hiver dernier, il a fallu hospitaliser la grand-mère de Camille à cause d'une mauvaise grippe.
sentences.en: Last winter, Camille's grandmother had to be hospitalized with a bad flu.
sentences.ko: 지난겨울 카미유의 할머니는 독감이 심해서 입원해야 했어요.

sentences.text: Sur le questionnaire médical, Lucas coche la case de l'asthme et note son inhalateur.
sentences.en: On the medical questionnaire, Lucas ticks the asthma box and notes his inhaler.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 문진표의 천식 칸에 표시하고 흡입기도 적어요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, le pollen réveille l'asthme de Camille.
sentences.en: In spring, pollen sets off Camille's asthma.
sentences.ko: 봄이면 꽃가루 때문에 카미유의 천식이 도져요.

sentences.text: Lucas arrive au cabinet les yeux cernés après une nuit de rage de dents.
sentences.en: Lucas arrives at the surgery with dark circles under his eyes after a night of toothache.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 밤새 치통에 시달려 눈 밑이 퀭한 채로 치과에 와요.

sentences.text: Avec les nuits plus longues de novembre, Camille a souvent les yeux cernés.
sentences.en: With the longer November nights, Camille often has dark circles under her eyes.
sentences.ko: 십일월 밤이 길어지면 카미유는 눈 밑이 자주 퀭해요.

sentences.text: Le cabinet du dentiste de Lucas est équipé pour les patients en situation de handicap.
sentences.en: Lucas's dentist's surgery is equipped for patients with disabilities.
sentences.ko: 뤼카가 다니는 치과는 장애가 있는 환자를 위한 시설이 갖춰져 있어요.

sentences.text: Camille trouve que l'hiver est un vrai handicap pour faire du vélo en ville.
sentences.en: Camille finds winter a real handicap for cycling in the city.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 겨울이 도시에서 자전거 타기에 큰 걸림돌이라고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Lucas raconte au dentiste qu'il s'est cassé une dent en faisant de la natation.
sentences.en: Lucas tells the dentist he chipped a tooth while swimming.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 치과 의사에게 수영하다가 이가 깨졌다고 말해요.

sentences.text: Dès les premiers beaux jours, Camille reprend la natation en piscine découverte.
sentences.en: As soon as the first fine days arrive, Camille goes back to swimming in the outdoor pool.
sentences.ko: 날이 풀리자마자 카미유는 야외 수영장에서 수영을 다시 시작해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste explique à Lucas que les vieux plombages ne causent pas d'empoisonnement au quotidien.
sentences.en: The dentist explains to Lucas that old fillings don't cause everyday poisoning.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카에게 오래된 충전재가 평소에 중독을 일으키지는 않는다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: En automne, Camille apprend à reconnaître les champignons pour éviter tout empoisonnement.
sentences.en: In autumn, Camille learns to recognize mushrooms to avoid any poisoning.
sentences.ko: 가을에 카미유는 중독되지 않으려고 버섯 구별하는 법을 배워요.

sentences.text: Les longs soins finissent par épuiser Lucas, qui s'endort presque dans le fauteuil.
sentences.en: The long treatment ends up exhausting Lucas, who almost falls asleep in the chair.
sentences.ko: 긴 치료에 지친 뤼카는 의자에서 거의 잠들 뻔해요.

sentences.text: La chaleur de l'été finit par épuiser Camille, qui rêve déjà de l'automne.
sentences.en: The summer heat ends up wearing Camille out, and she's already dreaming of autumn.
sentences.ko: 여름 더위에 지친 카미유는 벌써 가을을 꿈꿔요.

sentences.text: Le bruit de la fraise est si fort que Lucas craint pour son ouïe.
sentences.en: The drill is so loud that Lucas fears for his hearing.
sentences.ko: 드릴 소리가 너무 커서 뤼카는 청력이 걱정돼요.

sentences.text: En hiver, la neige étouffe les sons, et Camille a l'impression de perdre l'ouïe.
sentences.en: In winter, the snow muffles sounds, and Camille feels as if she's lost her hearing.
sentences.ko: 겨울에 눈이 소리를 삼켜서 카미유는 귀가 안 들리는 것 같아요.

sentences.text: Lucas observe les gants et le masque chirurgical que l'assistante enfile avant chaque patient.
sentences.en: Lucas watches the gloves and surgical mask the assistant puts on before each patient.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 조무사가 환자마다 끼는 장갑과 수술용 마스크를 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Camille garde des masques chirurgicaux dans son sac contre le pollen.
sentences.en: In spring, Camille keeps surgical masks in her bag against pollen.
sentences.ko: 봄에 카미유는 꽃가루 때문에 가방에 수술용 마스크를 넣고 다녀요.

sentences.text: Lucas plaisante qu'il souffre d'amnésie dès qu'il faut prendre rendez-vous chez le dentiste.
sentences.en: Lucas jokes that he gets amnesia whenever he has to book a dentist appointment.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 치과 예약할 때만 되면 기억상실증이 온다고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Chaque automne, Camille semble atteinte d'amnésie et oublie où elle a rangé ses gants.
sentences.en: Every autumn, Camille seems to get amnesia and forgets where she put her gloves.
sentences.ko: 가을마다 카미유는 기억상실증이라도 걸린 듯 장갑을 어디 뒀는지 잊어요.

sentences.text: Pour vaincre sa peur, Lucas a essayé une séance d'hypnose avant ses soins dentaires.
sentences.en: To beat his fear, Lucas tried a hypnosis session before his dental treatment.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 무서움을 이기려고 치과 치료 전에 최면 요법을 받아 봤어요.

sentences.text: Le crépitement de la pluie sur le toit plonge Camille dans une sorte d'hypnose.
sentences.en: The patter of rain on the roof puts Camille into a kind of trance.
sentences.ko: 지붕에 떨어지는 빗소리에 카미유는 최면에 걸린 듯해요.

sentences.text: À cause de la crise sanitaire, Lucas doit attendre dehors avant d'entrer au cabinet.
sentences.en: Because of the health crisis, Lucas has to wait outside before entering the surgery.
sentences.ko: 보건 위기 때문에 뤼카는 치과에 들어가기 전에 밖에서 기다려야 해요.

sentences.text: Pendant la canicule, la ville de Camille déclenche une alerte sanitaire pour les personnes âgées.
sentences.en: During the heatwave, Camille's town issues a health alert for the elderly.
sentences.ko: 폭염 동안 카미유가 사는 도시는 노인을 위한 보건 경보를 내려요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste conseille à Lucas de moins grignoter s'il veut maigrir et protéger ses dents.
sentences.en: The dentist advises Lucas to snack less if he wants to lose weight and protect his teeth.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 살을 빼고 이도 지키려면 간식을 줄이라고 뤼카에게 말해요.

sentences.text: Camille veut maigrir un peu avant l'été et se remet à marcher chaque soir.
sentences.en: Camille wants to lose a little weight before summer and starts walking every evening again.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 여름 전에 살을 좀 빼려고 매일 저녁 다시 걸어요.

sentences.text: Après sa chute à vélo, Lucas est sorti presque indemne, à part une incisive cassée.
sentences.en: After his bike fall, Lucas came out almost unhurt, apart from a broken incisor.
sentences.ko: 자전거 사고 뒤 뤼카는 앞니 하나가 깨진 것 말고는 거의 멀쩡했어요.

sentences.text: La tempête d'automne a arraché le toit du cabanon, mais le potager de Camille est resté indemne.
sentences.en: The autumn storm ripped the roof off the shed, but Camille's vegetable patch came through unharmed.
sentences.ko: 가을 폭풍에 창고 지붕이 날아갔지만 카미유의 텃밭은 멀쩡했어요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste parle à Lucas d'une technique de transplantation de gencive pour couvrir la racine.
sentences.en: The dentist tells Lucas about a gum graft technique to cover the root.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카에게 뿌리를 덮는 잇몸 이식 기술을 이야기해요.

sentences.text: Camille prépare la transplantation de ses jeunes plants de tomates au jardin en mai.
sentences.en: Camille is getting ready to transplant her tomato seedlings into the garden in May.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 오월에 토마토 모종을 밭에 옮겨 심을 준비를 해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste promet à Lucas un rétablissement rapide après l'extraction.
sentences.en: The dentist promises Lucas a quick recovery after the extraction.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카에게 발치 뒤 금방 회복될 거라고 해요.

sentences.text: Après une longue grippe, Camille profite du printemps pour son rétablissement.
sentences.en: After a long flu, Camille makes the most of spring to recover.
sentences.ko: 오래 독감을 앓은 카미유는 봄을 맞아 몸을 추슬러요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste palpe le cou de Lucas pour vérifier qu'aucune glande n'est enflée.
sentences.en: The dentist feels Lucas's neck to check that no gland is swollen.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 붓은 샘이 없는지 뤼카의 목을 만져 봐요.

sentences.text: Le médecin explique à Camille que la glande thyroïde peut rendre plus frileux en hiver.
sentences.en: The doctor explains to Camille that the thyroid gland can make you feel the cold more in winter.
sentences.ko: 의사는 카미유에게 갑상샘 때문에 겨울에 추위를 더 탈 수 있다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Sous l'anesthésie, Lucas ne sent plus sa lèvre et un filet de bave lui coule sur le menton.
sentences.en: Under the anesthetic, Lucas can't feel his lip and a trickle of drool runs down his chin.
sentences.ko: 마취 때문에 입술 감각이 없는 뤼카의 턱으로 침이 흘러요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Camille trouve de la bave d'escargot partout sur les feuilles de salade.
sentences.en: In spring, Camille finds snail slime all over the lettuce leaves.
sentences.ko: 봄이면 카미유는 상추 잎마다 달팽이 점액을 발견해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste explique à Lucas qu'un caillot doit se former dans le trou pour bien cicatriser.
sentences.en: The dentist explains to Lucas that a clot needs to form in the socket for it to heal properly.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 잘 아물려면 구멍에 핏덩이가 생겨야 한다고 뤼카에게 설명해요.

sentences.text: Le médecin rappelle à Camille de bouger pendant les longs trajets d'été pour éviter un caillot.
sentences.en: The doctor reminds Camille to move around on long summer journeys to avoid a clot.
sentences.ko: 의사는 카미유에게 여름 장거리 이동 때 혈전이 생기지 않게 몸을 움직이라고 해요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste de Lucas accroche des dessins d'enfants très colorés au plafond pour détendre les patients.
sentences.en: Lucas's dentist hangs very colourful children's drawings on the ceiling to relax patients.
sentences.ko: 뤼카의 치과 의사는 환자들이 편안해지게 천장에 알록달록한 아이 그림을 붙여 둬요.

sentences.text: En octobre, Camille ramasse les feuilles les plus colorées pour décorer la table.
sentences.en: In October, Camille gathers the most colourful leaves to decorate the table.
sentences.ko: 시월에 카미유는 가장 알록달록한 잎을 주워 식탁을 꾸며요.

sentences.text: Allongé la bouche ouverte, Lucas se sent complètement désarmé face aux questions du dentiste.
sentences.en: Lying with his mouth open, Lucas feels completely helpless before the dentist's questions.
sentences.ko: 입을 벌리고 누운 뤼카는 치과 의사의 질문 앞에서 완전히 무력해요.

sentences.text: Face à la première neige, le petit frère de Camille reste désarmé et ne sait pas quoi faire.
sentences.en: Faced with the first snow, Camille's little brother is at a loss and doesn't know what to do.
sentences.ko: 첫눈 앞에서 카미유의 남동생은 어쩔 줄 몰라 해요.

sentences.text: La radio montre un état catastrophique des dents du fond, et Lucas grimace.
sentences.en: The X-ray shows the back teeth in a disastrous state, and Lucas winces.
sentences.ko: 엑스레이에 어금니 상태가 엉망으로 나오자 뤼카는 얼굴을 찡그려요.

sentences.text: Le printemps pluvieux a été catastrophique pour les cerisiers du voisin de Camille.
sentences.en: The rainy spring was a disaster for the cherry trees of Camille's neighbor.
sentences.ko: 비가 잦은 봄이 카미유 이웃의 벚나무에는 재앙이었어요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste doit rouvrir l'ancienne carie de Lucas pour la nettoyer à fond.
sentences.en: The dentist has to reopen Lucas's old cavity to clean it thoroughly.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카의 예전 충치를 다시 열어 깨끗이 치료해야 해요.

sentences.text: En avril, Camille a hâte de voir le glacier du coin rouvrir après l'hiver.
sentences.en: In April, Camille can't wait to see the local ice-cream shop reopen after winter.
sentences.ko: 사월에 카미유는 동네 아이스크림 가게가 겨울을 지나 다시 문 열기를 기다려요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste a réussi à convertir Lucas au fil dentaire après des années d'efforts.
sentences.en: The dentist finally managed to convert Lucas to flossing after years of trying.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 몇 년 만에 뤼카가 치실을 쓰게 만들었어요.

sentences.text: Camille veut convertir la véranda en petit jardin d'hiver.
sentences.en: Camille wants to convert the veranda into a small winter garden.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 베란다를 작은 겨울 정원으로 바꾸고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Lucas admire la façon dont le dentiste sait manier ses petits instruments avec précision.
sentences.en: Lucas admires how precisely the dentist handles his small instruments.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 치과 의사가 작은 기구를 정확하게 다루는 솜씨에 감탄해요.

sentences.text: En automne, Camille apprend à manier la tronçonneuse pour couper le bois de chauffage.
sentences.en: In autumn, Camille learns to handle the chainsaw to cut firewood.
sentences.ko: 가을에 카미유는 땔감을 자르려고 전기톱 다루는 법을 배워요.

sentences.text: Lucas remercie la réceptionniste pour son accueil gracieux malgré son retard.
sentences.en: Lucas thanks the receptionist for her gracious welcome despite his being late.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 늦었는데도 친절하게 맞아 준 접수원에게 고마워해요.

sentences.text: Camille regarde les premières hirondelles dessiner des courbes gracieuses dans le ciel d'avril.
sentences.en: Camille watches the first swallows trace graceful curves in the April sky.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 사월 하늘에 우아한 곡선을 그리는 첫 제비들을 봐요.

sentences.text: Lucas compte : c'est la dixième fois cette année qu'il vient chez le dentiste.
sentences.en: Lucas counts: this is the tenth time this year he's been to the dentist.
sentences.ko: 뤼카가 세어 보니 올해 치과에 온 게 벌써 열 번째예요.

sentences.text: Camille note que c'est déjà le dixième jour de pluie de suite ce mois-ci.
sentences.en: Camille notes that it's already the tenth day of rain in a row this month.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 이번 달 벌써 열흘째 비가 온다고 적어요.

sentences.text: Dans la vitrine du cabinet, Lucas remarque un fauteuil de dentiste en miniature.
sentences.en: In the surgery's display case, Lucas notices a miniature dentist's chair.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 치과 진열장에서 작은 모형 치과 의자를 발견해요.

sentences.text: Camille aménage un jardin japonais en miniature sur son balcon pour le printemps.
sentences.en: Camille sets up a miniature Japanese garden on her balcony for spring.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 봄을 맞아 발코니에 작은 일본식 정원을 꾸며요.

sentences.text: Lucas trouve que le coût brut des implants est énorme avant le remboursement.
sentences.en: Lucas finds the gross cost of implants huge before reimbursement.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 환급 전 임플란트 비용이 엄청나다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Camille aime le style brut de sa maison en pierre, si fraîche en été.
sentences.en: Camille loves the raw style of her stone house, so cool in summer.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 여름에 아주 시원한 돌집의 거친 멋을 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Lucas déteste ce goût abominable du produit que le dentiste applique sur ses dents.
sentences.en: Lucas hates the awful taste of the product the dentist puts on his teeth.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 치과 의사가 이에 바르는 약의 끔찍한 맛을 싫어해요.

sentences.text: Le temps de février est vraiment abominable cette année, se plaint Camille.
sentences.en: The February weather is truly awful this year, Camille complains.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 올해 이월 날씨가 정말 끔찍하다고 투덜대요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste constate un progrès significatif dans l'hygiène dentaire de Lucas.
sentences.en: The dentist notes significant progress in Lucas's dental hygiene.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 뤼카의 구강 위생이 눈에 띄게 좋아졌다고 해요.

sentences.text: Camille note une baisse significative des températures depuis le début de la semaine.
sentences.en: Camille notes a significant drop in temperatures since the start of the week.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 이번 주 들어 기온이 눈에 띄게 떨어졌다고 적어요.

sentences.text: Lucas doit confronter sa peur du dentiste pour enfin faire soigner sa molaire.
sentences.en: Lucas has to face his fear of the dentist to finally get his molar treated.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 어금니를 치료하려면 치과 공포를 이겨 내야 해요.

sentences.text: Chaque hiver, Camille doit confronter ses plantes au gel et en perd toujours quelques-unes.
sentences.en: Every winter, Camille's plants have to face the frost, and she always loses a few.
sentences.ko: 겨울마다 카미유의 화초는 서리를 견뎌야 하고 늘 몇 개는 죽어요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste va déconseiller à Lucas de mâcher du chewing-gum pendant quelques jours.
sentences.en: The dentist is going to advise Lucas against chewing gum for a few days.
sentences.ko: 치과 의사는 며칠 동안 껌을 씹지 말라고 뤼카에게 말할 거예요.

sentences.text: La météo va déconseiller aux habitants de sortir pendant la tempête, prévient Camille.
sentences.en: The weather service is going to advise residents not to go out during the storm, Camille warns.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 기상청이 폭풍 동안 외출하지 말라고 권할 거라고 알려요.

sentences.text: Un peu étourdi par l'anesthésie, Lucas se lève lentement du fauteuil.
sentences.en: A little dizzy from the anesthetic, Lucas gets up slowly from the chair.
sentences.ko: 마취 때문에 조금 어지러운 뤼카는 의자에서 천천히 일어나요.

sentences.text: Camille est si étourdie qu'elle sort en sandales le premier jour de neige.
sentences.en: Camille is so scatterbrained that she goes out in sandals on the first day of snow.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 덜렁대서 첫눈 오는 날 샌들을 신고 나가요.

sentences.text: Le dentiste de Lucas a étudié dans une université prestigieuse à l'étranger.
sentences.en: Lucas's dentist studied at a prestigious university abroad.
sentences.ko: 뤼카의 치과 의사는 외국의 명문 대학에서 공부했어요.

sentences.text: En été, Camille assiste à un festival de musique prestigieux dans un château de la région.
sentences.en: In summer, Camille attends a prestigious music festival in a château in the region.
sentences.ko: 여름에 카미유는 지역 성에서 열리는 유명 음악 축제에 가요.
